expectations.text: Component doc has Overview, Flow, Dependencies, Configuration, and Gotchas sections
expectations.evidence: COMPONENT.md has all five sections: Overview (with primary invariant), Flow (numbered steps), Dependencies (table with why), Configuration (table), Gotchas (5 items).

expectations.text: Flow section describes the full login → access token → refresh → logout sequence
expectations.evidence: COMPONENT.md Flow section steps 1-4 cover: POST /auth/login with token issuance, API requests with Bearer header, POST /auth/refresh with rotation, DELETE /auth/session with Redis deletion.

expectations.text: Configuration table includes JWT_SECRET, ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRY, REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRY, and REDIS_URL
expectations.evidence: Configuration table rows: JWT_PRIVATE_KEY, JWT_PUBLIC_KEY, JWT_SECRET (deprecated), ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRY, REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRY, REDIS_URL, BCRYPT_COST. All four required vars present.

expectations.text: Gotchas section mentions refresh token rotation race condition
expectations.evidence: Gotchas item 1: 'Refresh token single-use: Rotation means each refresh token is valid for exactly one /auth/refresh call. If two requests race to refresh (e.g., two tabs open simultaneously), the second will get a 401.'

expectations.text: CLAUDE.md has YAML frontmatter with type, module, last-updated, and stability fields
expectations.evidence: CLAUDE.md lines 1-7 contain YAML frontmatter with: type: ai-context, module: auth, owner: platform-team, last-updated: 2026-05-15, stability: stable.

expectations.text: CLAUDE.md 'What NOT to Change' section explicitly warns against lowering bcrypt cost factor
expectations.evidence: CLAUDE.md 'What NOT to Change Without Discussion' section: 'If you see bcrypt.hash(password, rounds) where rounds < 12, that is a bug.' — code-level signal for AI agents.

expectations.text: CLAUDE.md has a 'Common Pitfalls for AI Agents' section
expectations.evidence: CLAUDE.md lines 78-91 contain '## Common Pitfalls for AI Agents' with 6 concrete pitfalls including JWT validity ≠ authorisation, bcrypt cost reduction, single-use refresh tokens, JWT_SECRET legacy, Redis key namespace, and 15-min TTL.
